items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1969-03-24
items.q: He reminded me so much of Johnny Dodds. That was another top clarinetist we had.

ctx.x: a little bit. What did you think of George as a clarinet player?
I think George was wonderful. He reminded me so much of Johnny Dodds. That was another top clarinetist we had. George reminded me so much of him.
What was it about George's playing that you liked?
